definitions.explanation: a person who challenges a champion or authority, or takes on a difficult endeavor

examples.japanese: {挑戦者|ちょうせんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れた→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。
{若|わか}い{挑戦者|ちょうせんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{王者|おうじゃ}→王者：13539_ouja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かった→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧。
examples.english: A young challenger stood up against the champion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦タイトル→タイトル：03855_taitoru⟧⟦マッチ→マッチ：02966_macchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{挑戦者|ちょうせんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}{勝|が}ち→逆転勝ち：08584_gyakutengachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}めた→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
examples.english: The challenger achieved a brilliant come-from-behind victory in the world title match.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧ (challenge) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Refers to someone who challenges a current holder of a title, record, or position. Frequently used in sports and competitive contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {挑戦者|ちょうせんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧: a challenger appears
- {挑戦者|ちょうせんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to face a challenger
- {挑戦者|ちょうせんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{退|しりぞ}ける→退ける：19588_shirizokeru⟧: to fend off a challenger
- ⟦{永遠|えいえん}→永遠：01873_eien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{挑戦者|ちょうせんしゃ}: eternal challenger

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{対戦相手|たいせんあいて}→対戦相手：29381_taisenaite⟧: opponent — neutral term for the other side in a match
- {競争相手|きょうそうあいて}: competitor — rival in a general competitive context
- ⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧: challenge — the act itself rather than the person
